status: Targeted RX synchronization optimization validated; full Wi-Fi throughput goal remains incomplete
root_cause: Every ARM exception and work completion scanned each active peer/TID count in uncached PE state even when no PE forwarding publication had occurred. Bounded live traces show repeated work invocations during reorder recovery.
implementation: Read the existing radio-wide forwarded-MSDU count first. It is published after per-TID guarded PN/SN state. When unchanged, skip per-TID publication reads but still run pending reorder recovery. A DMA read barrier orders changed-count observation before state snapshots.
production_scope: Only rx.c and its focused regression; cached payload allocation and event instrumentation are not production changes.

validation.actual_function_regression: inactive shared reads32->1; new PN/SN/counters synchronized exactly once; pending reorder recovery still runs without new forwarding
validation.live_scope: HE80, cached-RX experimental module with bounded memory trace, native FE to CPU16 GRO sink and actual TCP; no physical PON egress
validation.limitations: Different RF/retransmission events and allocation times; throughput difference is not a controlled RF benchmark. Remaining CPU includes simulated endpoint/softirq work. No full test suite or firmware flash.

first_gap_evidence.interpretation: Observed gap and retry with mutually consistent PE/software state; RDU is not necessary for every gap. Does not identify RF versus pre-delivery hardware loss.
